security_audit.summary: Most static alerts are false positives from Markdown fences, tables, and trading terminology. The real risk is that the skill asks agents to run curl and bun dev commands against a localhost workflow. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running curl or bun commands. Present these steps as optional manual actions.
Replace /Users/abuusama/projects/bots/signals with a relative path, setup variable, or neutral installation instruction.
Document that the skill expects a trusted localhost:3001 service and should not call other hosts without user approval.

content.value_statement: Traders need fast, structured interpretation of SMC signals across timeframes. This skill turns chart data into bias, entries, stops, targets, and risk notes.
actual_capabilities: Uses the documented localhost chart API to request mechanical SMC data.
Interprets premium and discount zones, liquidity, FVGs, sweeps, BOS, and ChoCH signals.
Builds trade setup summaries with direction, entry zone, stop loss, targets, and risk ratios.
Applies killzone timing and a confluence checklist to grade setup quality.
Formats results with warnings, a plain-language narrative, and risk guidance.
limitations: Requires a separate trusted local web app at localhost:3001.
Does not include the market data server or exchange connection.
API examples list BTC, ETH, and SOL unless the local app adds more markets.
Outputs are analysis support, not financial advice or guaranteed results.

use_cases.title: Plan a Crypto Setup
use_cases.description: Review BTC, ETH, or SOL structure before deciding whether a setup has enough confluence.

use_cases.title: Create a Market Brief
use_cases.description: Turn mechanical chart data into a structured SMC brief with bias, liquidity, and invalidation levels.

use_cases.title: Teach SMC Concepts
use_cases.description: Explain liquidity sweeps, FVGs, and market structure through a consistent analysis template.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Market Analysis
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze BTC/USDT on the 1h timeframe using intraday style. Include bias, setup grade, entry zone, stop, targets, warnings, and narrative.

prompt_templates.title: Multi-Timeframe Setup
prompt_templates.prompt: Use 4h for bias and 15m for entry on ETH/USDT. Explain confluence, missing confirmation, invalidation, and likely liquidity targets.

prompt_templates.title: Scenario Comparison
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare long and short scenarios for SOL/USDT. Mark the preferred plan, invalidation level, setup grade, and target liquidity.

prompt_templates.title: Thesis Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced critique of an existing idea
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this SMC thesis against the mechanical data: [paste thesis]. Challenge weak assumptions, grade confluence, and propose safer alternatives.

output_examples.output: Bias: bullish with premium-zone caution. Plan: wait for a pullback into the bullish FVG, place risk below structure, and target buy-side liquidity.

output_examples.input: Use 4h bias and 15m entry data for ETH/USDT.
output_examples.output: The higher timeframe is neutral-to-bullish. Entry quality improves only after a 15m sweep and ChoCH confirm demand near discount.

output_examples.input: Review my long thesis after a liquidity sweep.
output_examples.output: The thesis has partial support. The sweep helps, but the setup needs cleaner displacement and a defined stop below the swept low.

best_practices: Use fresh mechanical data before producing a setup.
Check higher-timeframe bias before planning a lower-timeframe entry.
Include a risk warning, setup grade, invalidation level, and missing confluence.
anti_patterns: Do not present any setup as guaranteed profit.
Do not force an A grade when confluence is weak.
Do not ignore stale data, session timing, or premium and discount context.

faq.question: Does this skill place trades?
faq.answer: No. It provides analysis and risk notes. The user makes all trading decisions.

faq.question: Does it need a local API?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions expect a trusted local service at localhost:3001.

faq.question: Which markets are shown in the examples?
faq.answer: The API reference lists BTC/USDT, ETH/USDT, and SOL/USDT.

faq.question: Is this financial advice?
faq.answer: No. Treat outputs as research support, not investment advice.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What data does it interpret?
faq.answer: It interprets structure, liquidity, FVGs, sweeps, order flow, and ATR data from the local service.
